description:
Vital Recorder is open with VitalDB Case #6 loaded. This recording contains physiological data from a surgical case.

Your task is to calculate hemodynamic indices at three specific timepoints:

1. Navigate to timestamp 00:15:00 (15 minutes).
2. Read the Heart Rate (HR), Systolic Blood Pressure (SBP), and Diastolic Blood Pressure (DBP) values.
3. Navigate to timestamp 00:45:00 (45 minutes) and read the same values.
4. Navigate to timestamp 01:15:00 (75 minutes) and read the same values.

5. For EACH timepoint, calculate:
   - Shock Index = HR / SBP
   - Pulse Pressure = SBP - DBP

6. Create a text file report at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\hemodynamic_indices_report.txt' with the exact format below:

HEMODYNAMIC INDICES REPORT
Case: VitalDB #6
==========================

Timepoint 1: 00:15:00
  HR: [value] bpm
  SBP: [value] mmHg
  DBP: [value] mmHg
  Shock Index: [value]
  Pulse Pressure: [value] mmHg

Timepoint 2: 00:45:00

Timepoint 3: 01:15:00
